glass
為甚麼一棟安靜公園旁的玻璃樓仍可能傷害鳥類？
Why might a glass building beside a quiet park still be risky for birds?
天空和樹木的倒影可能看起來像可飛入的空間。
Reflections of sky and trees may look like open flying space.
只要建築旁有樹，鳥類就較容易辨認玻璃。
Trees beside the building help birds recognise the glass surface.
沒有車輛噪音時，鳥類較容易察覺透明玻璃。
Without traffic noise, birds can more easily notice clear glass.
安靜與植被不能消除玻璃風險。倒影和透明通道都可能讓障礙不易被辨認。
Quiet surroundings do not remove glass risk. Reflections and transparent passages can make barriers hard to recognise.
patterns
marked
哪種玻璃改進較能幫助鳥類辨認障礙？
Which glass improvement better helps birds recognise a barrier?
在外表面使用合適、清晰且密集重複的圖案。
Use suitable, visible, closely repeated patterns on the outside.
在大玻璃中央放一張大貼紙，其他地方保持透明。
Place one large sticker in the centre and leave the rest clear.
保留清晰的天空倒影，幫助鳥類辨認天空方向。
Keep clear sky reflections to help birds find the sky’s direction.
合適的外部圖案可顯示玻璃表面；大面積未標記空隙仍可能看似暢通。這能降低風險，但不能消除每次碰撞。
Suitable outside patterns reveal the surface. Large unmarked gaps may still look open. Patterns reduce risk without preventing every collision.
lighting
light
遷徙季節，學校夜間應怎樣管理照明？
How should a school manage its lighting at night during migration?
關掉不必要的燈，讓必要的燈向下照並控制亮度。
Switch off unused lights and aim necessary light down at a suitable brightness.
保留外牆照明，只把所有白燈換成較暖色的燈。
Keep facade lighting on and change the white bulbs to warmer ones.
讓玻璃窗更亮，幫助經過的鳥類從遠處看見大樓。
Brighten the windows so passing birds can see the building from farther away.
減少多餘光線，比只換燈色更完整。人工照明可能影響部分鳥類，程度取決於物種、地點和天氣。
Reducing unnecessary light does more than changing its colour. Some birds can be affected; effects depend on species, location and weather.
habitat
green
兩個公園大小相近，甚麼資料最能幫助比較鳥類棲地？
Two parks are about the same size. What best helps compare their bird habitats?
比較食物、水源、植被遮蔽、連接和人為干擾。
Compare food, water, plant cover, connections and human disturbance.
比較草坪面積和剪草頻率，選草坪較整齊的公園。
Compare lawn size and mowing frequency, favouring the tidier lawn.
比較樹木總數和樹高，選最高樹木較多的公園。
Compare tree numbers and height, favouring the park with taller trees.
樹木和草坪只是部分線索。鳥類需要的資源和安靜空間因物種而異，相連棲地也很重要。
Trees and lawns tell only part of the story. Resources and quiet space matter, needs vary between species, and habitat connections help.
pond-management
pond
魚塘怎樣才能更好地支持部分水鳥？
How can fishponds better support some waterbirds?
管理水位與食物條件，並減少覓食區附近的干擾。
Manage water levels and food conditions, and reduce disturbance near feeding areas.
增加養魚數量並保持深水，使岸邊一直有較多魚。
Stock more fish and keep deep water so more fish stay near the banks.
把岸邊植物清除，讓鳥類從各方向都能看到水面。
Clear bank vegetation so birds can see the water from every direction.
有魚不代表鳥類能吃到。水深、可取得的食物和干擾影響不同鳥種；魚塘不能取代天然濕地。
Fish being present does not mean birds can reach them. Depth, accessible food and disturbance affect species differently. Ponds do not replace natural wetlands.
wetland-network
wetland
為甚麼米埔需要不同類型的濕地棲地？
Why does Mai Po need different kinds of wetland habitat?
不同棲地提供不同的覓食、休息和遮蔽條件。
Different habitats provide different feeding, resting and shelter conditions.
把泥灘改成較深的塘，可以增加鳥類可用的水域。
Turning mudflats into deeper ponds can increase usable water for birds.
集中保護遊客看到最多鳥的地點，會更有效率。
Focusing protection on the place visitors see most birds is more efficient.
不同水鳥在不同時候使用泥灘、水域和植被。保護相連的多樣棲地，比只保留單一類型更能照顧牠們的需要。
Waterbirds use mudflats, water and vegetation at different times. Protecting connected, varied habitats supports more needs than keeping just one kind.
